items.source: Annotation to declare an appropriate TemporalType on query method parameters. Note that this annotation can only be used on parameters of type Date.
items.translation: 用于声明查询方法参数上适当的TemporalType的注解。请注意，此注解只能用于类型为Date的参数。

items.source: Deprecated, for removal: This API element is subject to removal in a future version.
items.translation: 已弃用，即将移除：此 API 元素将在未来版本中被移除。

items.source: since 4.0. Please use java.time types instead.
items.translation: 自 4.0 版本起，请使用 java.time 类型。
